about: A first notebook on a machine that has never installed anything: an empty depot, so Pluto and DataFrames install while the agent works. DataFrames is new to the notebook, so the run asks first (#397), and the harness says yes in Endeavor's dialog. Tags: first run, package install. While packages install, the tools say so and a read of a queued cell waits for it, so the agent waits and reports the table (#58).
